repo_notes.content: DisTube is a Discord music bot library with a v6 public API centered on adapters, explicit voice plugins, source plugins, queue methods, and typed event payloads. Prioritize end-user documentation for bot authors over contributor-oriented implementation details.
repo_notes.author: Skick

repo_notes.content: Prefer the current v6 API in examples: `new DisTube(createDiscordJsAdapter(client), { plugins: [...] })`, `DisTubeEvent`, payload-object event handlers, and queue instance methods such as `queue.pause()`, `queue.skip()`, and `queue.filters.add(...)`. Do not teach removed pre-v6 shortcuts like `new DisTube(client, ...)` or `distube.pause(guildId)` except in migration pages.
repo_notes.author: Skick

repo_notes.content: Keep DeepWiki focused on public API usage, setup, migration, and troubleshooting. Avoid internal architecture, plugin SPI/lifecycle internals, contributor workflows, and maintainer-only specifications. If reference pages are generated, limit them to public classes, public options, public events, and other symbols bot users directly interact with.
repo_notes.author: Skick

repo_notes.content: Include only a small, clearly separated developer corner. Keep it concise and secondary to the main user documentation. Use it for high-level plugin authoring guidance and a lightweight architecture overview, not for exhaustive internal specs or rollout plans.
repo_notes.author: Skick

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Wiki landing page with links to the main public API usage guides.

page_notes.content: Keep this page short and navigational. Link to Installation, Quick Start Example, DisTube Guide, Projects Hub, Voice Plugin Setup, Major Upgrade Guide, Frequently Asked Questions, and the hosted API docs.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Entry point for users setting up DisTube in a bot for the first time.

pages.title: Installation
pages.purpose: Requirements and package installation for the public DisTube stack.

page_notes.content: Cover Node.js >= 22.12.0, FFmpeg, an adapter package such as `@distube/discord.js`, one voice plugin (`@distube/djsvoice` or `@distube/lavalink`), and one or more source plugins.

pages.title: Quick Start Example
pages.purpose: Minimal working bot example using the current v6 public API.

page_notes.content: Use a concise Discord.js example with `createDiscordJsAdapter`, `DjsVoicePlugin`, and a source plugin such as `YouTubePlugin`. Show `distube.play(...)`, `DisTubeEvent.PLAY_SONG`, and a few queue operations.

pages.title: DisTube Guide
pages.purpose: Primary guide for everyday public API usage after installation.

page_notes.content: Focus on creating a `DisTube` instance, handling events with payload objects, playing songs, reading queue state, controlling queues with queue methods, and using `queue.filters`.

pages.title: Projects Hub
pages.purpose: Package selection guide for official plugins, community packages, and example bots.

page_notes.content: Include capability tables for voice and source plugins, then a practical decision guide explaining which plugin combinations fit common bot setups.

pages.title: Usage Guides
pages.purpose: Focused guides for specific public API workflows and deployment choices.

pages.title: Handling Discord.js Events
pages.purpose: How to combine Discord.js voice state events with the public DisTube API.

page_notes.content: Show public patterns such as checking `distube.getQueue(guildId)`, using `distube.voices.get(guildId)`, and responding to `voiceStateUpdate` without depending on internals.

pages.title: Voice Plugin Setup
pages.purpose: How to choose and configure a supported voice plugin.

page_notes.content: Compare `@distube/djsvoice` and `@distube/lavalink` from a user perspective. Use public constructor examples only.

pages.title: Lavalink Guide
pages.purpose: User-facing setup and usage guide for the Lavalink plugin.

page_notes.content: Cover installation, basic node configuration, multi-node examples, normal `distube.play(...)` usage, relevant plugin events, and common troubleshooting.

pages.title: YouTube Authentication
pages.purpose: Guide for configuring the YouTube plugin to handle cookies, TV login, and rate limits.

page_notes.content: Focus on public `YouTubePlugin` options such as `session.cookie`, `tvLogin`, `silentLogin`, and supported client types. Keep the page user-facing and operational.

pages.title: Major Upgrade Guide
pages.purpose: Migration guide for users upgrading older bots to the v6 public API.

page_notes.content: Explain public breaking changes such as adapters, explicit voice plugins, payload-object events, async queue methods, `queue.filters`, and removed shortcut methods.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.purpose: Troubleshooting page for common runtime and configuration issues.

page_notes.content: Cover FFmpeg, voice connection timeouts, Opus/encryption dependencies, autoplay defaults, YouTube plugin setup, and similar user-facing issues.

pages.title: Public API Reference
pages.purpose: Reference pages for the public surfaces bot authors actually use.

pages.title: DisTube Class & Options
pages.purpose: Reference for constructing `DisTube` and configuring public options.

page_notes.content: Document the public constructor shape, adapter usage, `plugins`, queue/event-related options, and other public configuration that bot authors set directly.

pages.title: Queue API
pages.purpose: Reference for queue properties, queue control methods, and filter usage.

page_notes.content: Focus on the public `Queue` surface: `pause`, `resume`, `skip`, `stop`, `shuffle`, `jump`, `seek`, `setRepeatMode`, `toggleAutoplay`, snapshots/read-only state, and `queue.filters`.

pages.title: Events & Payloads
pages.purpose: Reference for `DisTubeEvent` values and their public payload shapes.

page_notes.content: Use the current v6 payload-object event model. Keep this page grounded in public event usage rather than internal emitters or coordinator details.

pages.title: Developer Corner
pages.purpose: Small, secondary section for plugin authors and contributors who need light implementation context.

pages.title: Plugin Development
pages.purpose: High-level guide for authors building custom DisTube plugins.

page_notes.content: Keep this page concise. Focus on public plugin-authoring concepts, the supported plugin categories, expected capabilities, and how custom plugins fit into the public `plugins` option. Avoid deep internal lifecycle or SPI details unless they are required for plugin authors.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Lightweight contributor-facing overview of the main runtime pieces.

page_notes.content: Explain the big pieces at a high level: adapters, voice plugins, source plugins, queues, events, and runtime ownership boundaries. Keep this page conceptual and short. Do not include implementation plans, internal migration specs, or maintainer-only details.
